description: Vehicles in traffic in Umeå municipality is a dataset listed in Opendataumea open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Umeå kommun. Number of vehicles in traffic in Umeå municipality at the end of the year, distributed by vehicle type and fuel. The statistics are based on information from Trafikanalys. Coverage: Umeå. The portal files it under Environment, Transport. Its keywords are Vehicles, Fuel. The portal shows 251 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-umea-se-portal.
